topic: End-of-service calculations that used to take a spreadsheet morning now run in seconds
format: Before/after of a single workflow: same task, two completely different experiences
post:
Four hours. Every Monday. Before the week had even started.

Pull the contracts. Cross-reference start dates. Check gratuity tiers. Build the spreadsheet. Double-check the math. Four hours, minimum — for one batch of leavers.

With SmartPRO Hub, the same output takes seconds.

Finance teams across Oman and the GCC are now processing end-of-service entitlements automatically — gratuity calculations, final settlement breakdowns, WPS payroll Oman compliance — without touching a single formula.

We built this because spreadsheet errors in final settlements aren't just a time sink. They cause disputes, stall offboarding, and put businesses on the wrong side of Ministry of Labour requirements. That's a bad combination.

One platform runs the calculation, flags discrepancies, and feeds directly into your payroll run. No manual cross-referencing. No Monday morning blocked out.

Worth asking your team: how many hours a month are you still paying for work that should already be done automatically?
